name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Pregnant woman in hiding as White House ends deportation protections for Haitian migrants
changes.summary: In Florida, a 29-year-old expectant mother is in hiding, concerned that she will be deported at any moment after the White House this week ended the Temporary Protected Status program for more than 300,000 Haitian nationals. Cristian Benavides has details.

changes.title: Trump to appeal White House ballroom ruling to Supreme Court
changes.summary: After a federal appeals court halted construction of the White House ballroom on Friday, President Trump said he would appeal the ruling to the Supreme Court. Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: 'I'm very good at grass.' Why Trump goes into the weeds on one of his favorite topics
changes.summary: President Donald Trump loves talking about grass, even in settings where such a topic might seem out of place. Since returning to the White House early last year, the Republican has spoken about grass at least 45 times in public events or interviews.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: A White House effort to delay a ban on intoxicating hemp was holding up a final agreement on a bipartisan spending bill ahead of a monthlong Senate recess.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: At the White House’s request, senators tucked a change sought by the hemp industry into a crucial spending bill. It would benefit the son-in-law of Susie Wiles, the president’s chief of staff.

changes.title: Trump Said Qatari Jet Was Destined for His Library. That May Change.
changes.summary: A White House official says no final decision has been made about which plane will go on display at the Trump presidential library. That leaves the fate of the Qatari jet unclear.

changes.title: FAA is investigating why a plane was allowed to take off as Trump's helicopter approached
changes.summary: The White House emphasized that President Trump was not in danger during the incident.
